organizer.general:
As one of the most influential robotics competitions in the world, the VEX Robotics Competition™ has gained widespread recognition globally. The Organizing Committee of the 2026 Silk Road VEX Robotics® Signature Event is proud to host this event and warmly invites renowned schools and outstanding teams to participate and jointly explore innovative approaches to talent development.

The event will conduct all judging and refereeing activities in accordance with the principles of fairness, impartiality, and transparency, ensuring a well-organized competition process and objective, equitable results.

For detailed information regarding payment methods and related matters, please contact:

[email protected]

                            Grade Level: Middle School

                Skills Challenge Offered: Yes

                    Judging Format: All In-Person Judging

                    Skills Challenge Offered for VURC/VAIRC teams: No

                Event Dates & Locations

                        Date: 3-Aug-2026 - 6-Aug-2026

                    Venue/Location:

        Changji Gymnasium

                    No.129 Nangongyuan W Rd

                            changji,
                            Xinjiang
                                    China

            Contact the Event Partner

                            You must login to contact this Event Partner
